notes: This stage consumes no neural checkpoint. Its first relevant smoke uses an actual source512 covariance matrix, then continues all remaining cells immediately.

Bounded signed projection uses exactly the current±.9 coefficient range. Other ideal spaces are unbounded representational ceilings, not deployed procedures.
No healthy process or scientific recipe is changed by this analysis.
